app.name: Relance
app.tagline: Follow-up emails, written for each person

footer.local: Your contacts are stored only in this browser, on this computer. Relance never sends email: it writes drafts that you send yourself.

placeholder.title: Not built yet
placeholder.body: This part of Relance is still being built. For now, you can manage your contacts.

fields.fullName: Full name (split into first and last)

contacts.title: Contacts

empty.title: You don't have any contacts yet
empty.body: Import a spreadsheet of your contacts, or add them one at a time. To try Relance first, load a few made-up sample contacts.
empty.sampleHint: It shows which columns work well.

contacts.sampleAlreadyLoaded: The sample contacts are already in your list.
contacts.sampleError: The sample contacts could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
contacts.noNotesHint: Drafts for this contact can't be personal until you add notes.
contacts.saveFailed: That change couldn't be saved. Please try again.

form.emailInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address.
form.languageHint: Automatic chooses the language from the country and your settings.
form.notesHint: The most important field. Write what you'd want to remember before emailing this person: what you talked about, what's happening for them, anything they mentioned.
form.serviceHistoryHint: What you've done together, if anything.
form.lastContactedHint: Leave empty if you've never been in touch.
form.saveFailed: The contact couldn't be saved. Please try again.
form.dateInvalid: Enter a full date, or leave it empty.

import.title: Import contacts from a spreadsheet
import.chooseIntro: Choose a CSV file. Most spreadsheet programs can save one:
import.howExcel: Excel: File → Save As → choose “CSV UTF-8”.
import.howSheets: Google Sheets: File → Download → Comma-separated values (.csv).
import.spreadsheetFile: This is a spreadsheet file, not a CSV file. Open it in your spreadsheet program, save it as CSV, then choose that file here.
import.readError: This file couldn't be read. Make sure it's a CSV file and try again.
import.emptyFile: This file has no rows to import.
import.mapIntro: Tell Relance what each column in your file contains. Where a column name was familiar, a choice has been filled in for you. Please check each one.
import.hasHeader: The first row contains column names
import.needName: To continue, choose which column holds first names (or full names).
import.missingName_one: {{count}} row has no first name and will be skipped.
import.missingName_other: {{count}} rows have no first name and will be skipped.
import.importFailed: The import didn't finish, and nothing was added. Please try again.
import.duplicates_one: {{count}} was already in your list (same email address) and was skipped.
import.duplicates_other: {{count}} were already in your list (same email address) and were skipped.
import.skippedName_one: {{count}} row had no first name and was skipped.
import.skippedName_other: {{count}} rows had no first name and were skipped.
import.unknownCountry_one: The country of {{count}} contact wasn't recognised, so it was left empty. You can set it by editing the contact.
import.unknownCountry_other: The country of {{count}} contacts wasn't recognised, so it was left empty. You can set it by editing each contact.
import.unknownDate_one: The last-contacted date of {{count}} contact couldn't be read, so it was left empty.
import.unknownDate_other: The last-contacted date of {{count}} contacts couldn't be read, so it was left empty.

storage.title: Relance can’t store your contacts in this browser
storage.body: Relance keeps everything on your own computer, inside the browser. This browser is currently not allowing that, which often happens in a private or incognito window.
storage.fix: Open this page in a normal browser window. If that doesn’t help, try another browser such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

create.title: Write emails
create.methodTemplate: Use the template text as it is
create.methodTemplateHint: Fills in names and your signature. No AI and no cost.
create.fallback_one: This template has no {{language}} version, so the {{fallback}} version will be used for {{count}} contact.
create.fallback_other: This template has no {{language}} version, so the {{fallback}} version will be used for {{count}} contacts.
create.noTemplates: There are no templates yet. You can add one in Settings.
create.failed: The drafts couldn't be created. Please try again.

review.title: Review

empty.title: No drafts yet
empty.body: To write emails, select contacts on the Contacts page and choose “Write emails”, or see who is due on the Due now page.

review.subject: Subject
review.saveFailed: Not saved. Check that this page is still open, then type again.
review.unknownPlaceholders: This email still contains {{list}}. Replace it before sending.
review.noneApproved: Approve the drafts you want to send, then export them here.

export.title: Export approved drafts
export.eml: Email files for Outlook (.eml files in a .zip)
export.emlHint: Each draft opens in Outlook as a new email, ready for you to read and send.
export.brevoHint: One row per draft with email, first name, last name, subject and text, to import into a Brevo campaign.
export.noEmail_one: {{count}} draft has no email address. Add it in your email program before sending.
export.noEmail_other: {{count}} drafts have no email address. Add them in your email program before sending.
export.markContacted_one: Mark this contact as contacted today
export.markContacted_other: Mark these {{count}} contacts as contacted today
export.markContactedHint: This keeps “Due now” accurate. Untick it if you won't send them today.
export.doneEml: Find the .zip file in your Downloads folder and double-click it to open it. Then open each email file: Outlook shows it as a new message. Read it, then press Send.
export.doneBrevo: In Brevo, import this file as contacts. The SUBJECT and BODY columns become contact attributes that you can use in a campaign.
export.failed: The export didn't work. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.more: More settings will appear here in a later version.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: Your contacts are stored only in this browser. Browsers sometimes clear stored data, so download a backup now and then and keep it somewhere safe. The backup does not include your API key.
backup.failed: The backup couldn't be created. Please try again.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.merge: Add to what is already here
restore.mergeHint: Keeps your current contacts and settings, and adds anything from the backup that is missing.
restore.replaceHint: Your current contacts, drafts, templates and settings are replaced by the backup. Your API key is kept.
restore.notJson: This file isn't a Relance backup. Choose the .json file that you downloaded from Relance.
restore.notBackup: This file isn't a Relance backup, or it is damaged.
restore.tooNew: This backup was made by a newer version of Relance. Reload this page to get the latest version, then try again.
restore.failed: The restore didn't finish, and nothing was changed.

backupReminder.title: Time for a backup
backupReminder.body: You have {{count}} contacts stored only in this browser. Download a backup so you don't lose them if the browser clears its data.
